label: makotospring2
title_zh: T 是时间（树与三人行）

lines.en: label makotospring2:
The next five minutes are agonizingly long as I have to suffer the full force of what it means to be the main character.
lines.zh: 接下来的五分钟漫长得令人煎熬，我不得不承受「当主角」这件事的全部重量。

lines.en: Despite the screaming, which can most assuredly be heard from the halls, no one comes to the rescue.
lines.zh: 尽管惨叫声在走廊上肯定听得一清二楚，却没有一个人来救她。

lines.en: No one leaves their room at all — because they’re only there when I need them to be or when the {b}SCRIPT{/b} calls for it.
lines.zh: 根本没有人离开自己的房间——因为他们只在我需要的时候、或者{b}剧本{/b}需要的时候才存在。

lines.en: And right now, that script only calls for pain — frightened yelps as the gazelle bleeds out before me while I realize I have never been a lion at all.
lines.zh: 而此刻，那剧本只要痛苦——惊恐的哀鸣，瞪羚在我面前流干血，而我终于意识到，我从来都不是狮子。

lines.en: I have been a poacher.
lines.zh: 我是个偷猎者。

lines.en: And I have gravely injured this animal while hunting a far more elusive, far more {i}valuable{/i} one.
lines.zh: 而在追逐一头更难以捉摸、更{i}值钱{/i}的猎物时，我重伤了这只动物。

lines.en: There are gazelles everywhere out here. Who am I supposed to sell this one to?
lines.zh: 这外面到处都是瞪羚。这一只，我该卖给谁？

lines.en: It isn’t worth it to waste another bullet. But I was born with the burden of guilt — so I’ve nothing left to do but sit and wait as the last bit of life drains from its body.
lines.zh: 再浪费一发子弹不值得。但我天生背负着愧疚这个重担——所以我无事可做，只能坐着等它体内最后一点生命流干。

lines.en: scene makotofindsher1
: Oh, wow. That {i}is{/i} a lot.
lines.zh: : 哦，哇。这可{i}真不少{/i}。

lines.en: I suppose I was exaggerating a bit. I’m sure that comes as no surprise, though.
lines.zh: 我想我刚才说得有点夸张了。不过你肯定一点都不意外。

lines.en: Clearly, Miku isn’t going to {i}die{/i} from this. She just might have some trouble sitting down for a while.
lines.zh: 显然，Miku 不会因此{i}死掉{/i}。她只是接下来一阵子坐着可能会有点困难。

lines.en: Or worse yet, this experience will add one more item to her growing list of traumas and, after today, she won’t want to have sex with me {i}at all{/i} as it will only bring back bad memories.
lines.zh: 或者更糟的是，这段经历会在她那份不断变长的创伤清单上再添一笔，从今以后她{i}再也{/i}不想和我做爱了，因为那只会勾起糟糕的回忆。

lines.en: : Ngh!!!! Ngh!!!! It still hurts!!! The pain...won’t stop!!!!
: What now? What are we supposed to do?
lines.zh: : 现在怎么办？我们该做什么？

lines.en: : Miku, do you think you need to go to the hospital?
lines.zh: : Miku，你觉得你需要去医院吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know! I think my vagina’s broken!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！我觉得我的阴道坏了！

lines.en: : Well, at least her sense of humor is intact.
lines.zh: : 好吧，至少她的幽默感还在。

lines.en: : I’m not joking! I seriously think it’s broken!
lines.zh: : 我不是在开玩笑！我是真的觉得它坏了！

lines.en: : Is that even possible?...
lines.zh: : 那玩意儿真能坏吗？……

lines.en: : I guess that depends on what she means by “broken.” You likely just tore something. {i}Other{/i} than what you very obviously tore by deflowering her, I mean.
lines.zh: : 那得看她说的「坏」是什么意思。你大概是撕裂了什么地方。我是说，{i}除了{/i}你给她破处时明显撕裂的那处之外。

lines.en: : I’m not gonna have to get friggin’ vagina stitches, am I?
lines.zh: : 我不会真得去缝他妈的阴道针吧？

lines.en: : Miku, do you remember how long it took for you to stop bleeding when you scraped your knee on the pavement playing soccer?
lines.zh: : Miku，你还记不记得，你踢足球时在人行道上擦破膝盖，流了多久的血才止住？

lines.en: : This ain’t my friggin’ knee we’re talkin’ about, Makoto! Sensei stuck it in my friggin’ cervix!
lines.zh: : 我们说的可不是我他妈的膝盖，Makoto！老师那玩意儿都戳进我他妈的子宫颈了！

lines.en: scene makotofindsher2

: He might have touched it, but he didn’t stick it {i}in{/i} your cervix, Miku. What I’m trying to get at is that this {i}always{/i} happens when you bleed. Your body just...doesn’t clot well, I guess?
lines.zh: : 他也许是碰到了，但没有戳{i}进{/i}你的子宫颈，Miku。我想说的是，你一流血{i}总是{/i}这样。你的身体大概就是……凝血不太好？

lines.en: : So what I’m hearin’ is this didn’t happen to you?!
lines.zh: : 所以你的意思是，你那时候没出这种事？！

lines.en: : Not like that, no. But...you’re {i}probably{/i} fine?
lines.zh: : 没到那种程度，没有。不过……你{i}大概{/i}没事吧？

lines.en: : Probably?! You don’t know?!
lines.zh: : 大概？！你也不知道？！

lines.en: scene makotofindsher3
: I mean...my {i}mom{/i} might? But calling her about this would be...well...
lines.zh: : 我是说……我{i}妈{/i}也许知道？但为了这个打电话给她，未免也……唉……

lines.en: : She might have some things to say to you about it once you settle down.
lines.zh: : 等你冷静下来，她大概还会有些话要跟你说。

lines.en: : {i}MNGGGHHH!{/i} I don’t even care anymore! She can talk about whatever she wants if she knows how to make this stop!
lines.zh: : {i}嗯啊啊啊！{/i}我已经什么都不管了！只要她知道怎么让它停下来，她爱说什么就说什么！

lines.en: scene makotofindsher4
: Sensei, what do you- can you {i}not{/i} look like that, please? It’s not like you killed her. You just...may have broken her vagina.
lines.zh: : 老师，你能不能——{i}别{/i}摆出那副表情，好吗？你又没杀了她。你只是……可能弄坏了她的阴道。

lines.en: : AAAAGGGHH! I KNEW IT! IT {i}IS{/i} BROKEN!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！我就知道！它{i}就是{/i}坏了！

lines.en: scene makotofindsher5
: Miku, I’m going to give you three options: wait out the pain with me, go to the hospital, or see if there’s something my mom can do.
lines.zh: : Miku，我给你三个选项：我陪你等痛过去、去医院，或者看我妈能不能想办法。

lines.en: : Mmmmngh! I don’t know! Just pick one for me!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯！我不知道！你替我选一个吧！

lines.en: : I think you should call Maki.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你应该打电话给 Maki。

lines.en: scene makotofindsher6
: I think so too. Especially if the pain is as bad as Miku says it is. You know what that means though, right?
lines.zh: : 我也这么想。尤其是如果真像 Miku 说的那么痛。不过你知道那意味着什么吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ll tell her it was me.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我会跟她说是我的错。

lines.en: scene makotofindsher7
: Wha- are you out of your fucking mind?! Absolutely not! It means you have to get the hell out of here before she {i}finds out{/i} it was you!
lines.zh: : 什——你他妈疯了吗？！绝对不行！那意味着你得在她{i}发现{/i}是你之前滚得远远的！

lines.en: : I’ll make up a story! I don’t want you gettin’ in trouble because’a me, Sensei! That ain’t fair to you! You didn’t do nothin’ wrong!
lines.zh: : 我会编个故事的！我不想因为我害老师惹上麻烦！那对你不公平！你又没做错什么！

lines.en: : ...Are you serious right now?
lines.zh: : ……你现在是认真的吗？

lines.en: : Yes! You wanted me to handle this, didn’t you? This is me handling it. Now, get the hell out of here so I can ask my mom about how to fix Miku’s vagina.
lines.zh: : 当然！你不是说我来处理吗？这就是我在处理。现在，给我滚出去，我好问我妈要怎么修好 Miku 的阴道。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Sensei...I’m really sorry! I tried to endure it, but I just-
lines.zh: : 对不起，老师……真的很对不起！我努力忍了，可我就是——

lines.en: scene makotofindsher8
: Miku, shh. Just try to calm down and hold still. I’ll find something to try and stop the bleeding.
lines.zh: : Miku，嘘。冷静一点，别动。我去找点东西试着止血。

lines.en: : Oh god, you ain’t gonna try to plug it up, are ya?! Ain’t no way I’m puttin’ anythin’ else in there right now! Not happenin’! No, ma’am!
lines.zh: : 天啊，你该不会想把它堵上吧？！我现在绝不可能再往里面塞任何东西了！想都别想！不行，女士！

lines.en: : I’m not going to plug it up, I’m-
lines.zh: : 我不会把它堵上的，我是——

lines.en: scene makotofindsher9
: Sensei, {i}why{/i} are you still here?! Leave!
lines.zh: : 老师，你{i}怎么{/i}还在这儿？！出去！

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
I make it back home in two pieces after stealing one from someone else.
lines.zh: 从别人身上偷走一块之后，我带着两块回到了家。

lines.en: A successful hunt, I do say. But the bounty, while it sustains me, is one that I can not lay upon the table and dig into with a fork and knife.
lines.zh: 一次成功的狩猎，我得说。可这笔猎获虽然能养活我，却没法摆在桌上用刀叉切开享用。

lines.en: I hold in my hands a pair of small horns, plucked from the skull of an animal. They’ll look lovely upon my mantle beside the countless others I have stolen.
lines.zh: 我手里握着一对小角，是从一只动物的头骨上摘下来的。它们摆在我的壁炉台上，和无数偷来的其他战利品放在一起，一定很好看。

lines.en: These ones will require some work, though. There’s flesh still at the roots. And bright, red blood drips from where they were removed.
lines.zh: 不过这一对还需要处理。根部还连着肉。被摘下来的地方还在滴着鲜红的血。

lines.en: It stains my hands and my floorboards, but it’s nothing that the grease of an elbow or an ammonia cocktail won’t take care of.
lines.zh: 血弄脏了我的手和地板，但没什么是一点肘部油脂或者氨水混合液对付不了的。

lines.en: I set them down and I wait for my phone to ring.
lines.zh: 我放下它们，等着我的电话响。

lines.en: It finally does.
lines.zh: 它终于响了。

lines.en: : I have good news, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 有个好消息，老师。

lines.en: : Miku’s vagina is {i}not{/i} broken.
lines.zh: : Miku 的阴道{i}没{/i}坏。
: 所以……

lines.en: : Maki was able to help?...
lines.zh: : Maki 帮上忙了？……

lines.en: : By driving her to the hospital, yes.
lines.zh: : 嗯，帮她开车去了医院，算是帮上了。

lines.en: : Wha-
: Just as a precaution, though.
lines.zh: : 不过只是以防万一。

lines.en: : The doctors said the bleeding would have eventually stopped on its own. But they gave her some pills to help with the pain and told her to take it easy for a while.
lines.zh: : 医生说过血最终会自己止住。但他们给她开了些止痛的药，还让她这段时间悠着点。

lines.en: : She’s now currently being lectured on safe sex. So in that regard, I guess a little good {i}did{/i} manage to come out of this.
lines.zh: : 她现在正在接受安全性行为的教育。所以从这点来看，这件事{i}倒是{/i}也有一点好处。

lines.en: : Do you feel guilty?
lines.zh: : 你觉得愧疚吗？

lines.en: : It’s kind of hard not to when it’s literally my fault.
lines.zh: : 这明明就是我的错，很难不愧疚。

lines.en: : Just be glad it happened the way it did and not with someone no one knew about. I suppose it’d be hard finding {i}anyone{/i} like that at this point, though.
lines.zh: : 你就庆幸事情是以这种方式发生的吧，而不是发生在某个没人知道的人身上。不过话说回来，到这个地步，恐怕也很难找到{i}那样的人{/i}了。

lines.en: : Listen...
lines.zh: : 听着……

lines.en: : I know it’s late. But would you want to meet up?
lines.zh: : 我知道很晚了。不过你想出来见一面吗？

lines.en: : I’m not really in the mood to have {i}more{/i} sex, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 我没心情{i}再{/i}做爱了，Makoto。

lines.en: : Really? Because, according to Miku, you never even finished. Unless you’re saying you finished {i}yourself{/i} off when you got home.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？据 Miku 说，你根本就没射出来。除非你是说你回家之后{i}自己{/i}解决了。

lines.en: : Makoto-
lines.zh: : Makoto——

lines.en: : I’m sorry...That was a joke. A poorly timed one, I’ll add.
lines.zh: : 对不起……那是开玩笑。而且时机很糟糕，我承认。

lines.en: : But Sensei, I {i}do{/i} want to see you. And not for sex either. We don’t {i}always{/i} have to do that, you know?
lines.zh: : 可是老师，我{i}真的{/i}想见你。也不是为了做爱。我们不用{i}每次{/i}都做那种事，你知道吧？

lines.en: : I just don’t want this sitting with you. Especially now that you’re actually an active participant in my life again after feeling sorry for yourself for so long.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让你一个人扛着这件事。尤其是在你自怨自艾了那么久、终于重新真正参与进我的生活之后。

lines.en: : So...how about we meet in the park?
lines.zh: : 所以……我们在公园见怎么样？

lines.en: : The park?...
: The one near the school.
lines.zh: : 学校附近那个。

lines.en: : That’s where everything started today. That’s where I met up with Miku.
lines.zh: : 今天一切就是从那儿开始的。我就是在那儿和 Miku 碰面的。

lines.en: : Heh...
: It seems like everything comes full circle nowadays, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 最近好像什么事情都会绕回原点，不是吗？

lines.en: : I’m still at the hospital right now, but I think we’ll be leaving soon. Can you maybe meet me there in...an hour?
lines.zh: : 我现在还在医院，不过我想我们快走了。你能不能……一小时后到那儿？

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t want to stay with Miku and make sure she’s okay?
lines.zh: : 你确定不想陪着 Miku、确认她没事吗？

lines.en: : She’s fine, Sensei. And extremely embarrassed right now, so it’ll probably be {i}good{/i} for me to leave her alone and let her wallow in shame for a bit.
lines.zh: : 她没事的，老师。而且她现在尴尬得要命，所以我{i}最好{/i}还是让她一个人待着，好好在羞耻里泡一会儿。

lines.en: scene black
: Okay.
: We’ll meet in an hour.
lines.zh: : 一小时后见。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
I can’t help but notice how soft my hands are now that I’ve washed the blood off of them.
lines.zh: 洗掉手上的血之后，我不由得注意到自己的手有多柔软。

lines.en: They were all I washed, though.
lines.zh: 可我洗的只有手。

lines.en: I’ve been afraid to take my pants off ever since putting them back on in Miku’s room as I know that glancing down at my weapon will do naught but remind me of the beast it killed tonight.
lines.zh: 自从在 Miku 房间里把裤子穿回去之后，我就一直不敢脱。因为我知道，只要低头看一眼自己那件武器，就只能想起它今晚杀死的那头野兽。

lines.en: Maybe I’m making a bigger deal out of this than it needs to be?
lines.zh: 也许是我把这件事看得太严重了？

lines.en: That’s how Makoto’s making it sound.
lines.zh: Makoto 的口气就是这么说的。

lines.en: That’s how the me inside of me is making it sound.
lines.zh: 我体内那个「我」的口气也是这么说的。

lines.en: And I’m sure that’s how Miku will make it sound too once she’s all better.
lines.zh: 而我相信等 Miku 好起来，她也会这么说。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 可是……

lines.en: To me, it feels like an omen.
lines.zh: 对我来说，这感觉像是一个预兆。

lines.en: To me, it feels like the universe telling me that my favorite hiding place isn’t safe anymore.
lines.zh: 对我来说，这感觉像是宇宙在告诉我，我最喜欢的藏身之处不再安全了。

lines.en: And that’s all the more terrifying since I’ve known I’ve been sleeping in the cave of a black bear ever since I began life here.
lines.zh: 而这一点更加可怕——因为从我在这儿开始生活的那天起，我就知道自己一直睡在一头黑熊的洞穴里。

lines.en: I didn’t think it would ever wake up.
lines.zh: 我没想到它有一天会醒。

lines.en: And now all I can do is worry that something will bite into {i}my{/i} neck next.
lines.zh: 而现在我唯一能做的，就是担心下一个被咬穿的是不是{i}我的{/i}脖子。

lines.en: : Thanks for coming.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你能来。

lines.en: scene makotofindsher10
: How do you feel?
lines.zh: : 你现在感觉怎么样？

lines.en: : Not so great, to tell you the truth.
lines.zh: : 说实话，不太好。

lines.en: : Yeah. You don’t {i}look{/i} so great either.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你{i}看起来{/i}也不太好。

lines.en: : Are you mad at me?
lines.zh: : 你生我的气吗？

lines.en: : Do you {i}want{/i} me to be mad at you?
lines.zh: : 你{i}希望{/i}我生你的气吗？

lines.en: : Kind of.
lines.zh: : 有点。

lines.en: : You want me to lecture you? Try and talk you out of repeating this same bad decision in the future when we both know that will do nothing to stop you?
lines.zh: : 你想让我说教你？想让我劝你以后别再犯同样的错——尽管我们俩都清楚那根本拦不住你？

lines.en: : Kind of...
lines.zh: : 有点……

lines.en: : Okay. I can do that.
lines.zh: : 好。我可以做到。

lines.en: scene makotofindsher11
: You made a very irresponsible decision tonight, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 老师，你今晚做了一个非常不负责任的决定。

lines.en: : The doctor did not hesitate to comment on how Miku’s body was very much {i}not{/i} meant to withstand “whatever it was” she attempted to put in there. And I’m sure that wasn’t lost on you.
lines.zh: : 医生毫不犹豫地评价说，Miku 的身体{i}根本{/i}承受不了她试图放进去的那个「东西」。我相信这一点你也没漏听。

lines.en: : You knew the damage you could potentially inflict on her. And while it would have been hard to guess just how much she’d bleed as a result of that due to a preexisting condition, it was still dangerous.
lines.zh: : 你知道自己可能给她造成什么样的伤害。虽然因为她的旧疾，很难预料她会因此流多少血，但那依然是危险的。

lines.en: : I get being caught up in the moment, but surely you must have noticed that you didn’t {i}fit...{/i}correct?
lines.zh: : 我理解你一时冲动，但你总该注意到自己……{i}不太合适{/i}吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, but...it’s never been like {i}that{/i} before. I knew it would hurt, I just didn’t think it would hurt her {i}that{/i} much.
lines.zh: : 嗯，可是……以前从来不是{i}这样{/i}的。我知道会痛，只是没想到会痛到{i}那种{/i}程度。

lines.en: scene makotofindsher12
: I’m sure it didn’t help that Miku isn’t good with blood. I imagine that seeing what you’d done to her was a larger contributing factor in the panic that ensued than the pain itself.
lines.zh: : 我敢说 Miku 怕血这件事也没帮上忙。我想，比起疼痛本身，看到你对自己做了什么，才是她随后陷入恐慌的更大原因。

lines.en: : But what’s done is done. And now you know to be more careful.
lines.zh: : 但事情已经发生了。现在你知道该更小心了。

lines.en: scene makotofindsher13
: A condom would have helped as well. The added lubrication certainly wouldn’t have been a negative.
lines.zh: : 戴个套也会有帮助。多一点润滑总不是坏事。

lines.en: : Is {i}she{/i} mad at me? Now that she’s started to...calm down, I guess?
lines.zh: : {i}她{/i}生我的气吗？现在她开始……冷静下来了，大概？

lines.en: scene makotofindsher14
: She feels guilty. And ashamed. What she imagined would be a special moment between you two ended in a trip to the hospital and you not getting any amount of pleasure {i}at all.{/i}
lines.zh: : 她觉得愧疚。也觉得羞耻。她想象中本该是你们俩之间一个特别的时刻，结果以一趟医院之行告终，而你从头到尾{i}一点{/i}快感都没得到。

lines.en: : So no, she’s not mad at {i}you.{/i} She’s mad at herself. And this will probably sound crazy, but I think most of us would feel the same way in her position.
lines.zh: : 所以不，她没有生{i}你的{/i}气。她在生自己的气。这话听起来大概很疯狂，但我想我们大多数人处在她的位置都会是同样的感受。

lines.en: : That’s because most of you are delusional.
lines.zh: : 那是因为你们大多数人都疯了。

lines.en: scene makotofindsher15

: Of course her body wasn’t meant to “withstand” me. It’s not fully developed yet. I’ve just been getting lucky so far. But all of you are so blinded by desire to be with me that you flat-out don’t care.
lines.zh: : 她的身体当然「承受不了」我。它还没发育完全。只是到目前为止我一直走运。可你们全都被想和我上床的欲望蒙住了眼，根本毫不在乎。

lines.en: : You’ll let me do anything I want to you because you think that’s the only way to my heart. And the worst fucking part is that you’re probably {i}right.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我做什么你们都愿意，因为你们觉得那是通往我心的唯一道路。而最他妈糟糕的是，你们{i}大概是对的{/i}。

lines.en: : So is this just the burden I need to bear from now on in order to keep feeling human? To know that something could go wrong at any second and I could severely physically damage you?
lines.zh: : 所以这就是我从此必须背负的重担吗——为了继续感觉自己是个人？明知道随时可能出岔子，我可能严重弄伤你们的身体？

lines.en: : You realize that all of that has to do with the fact that you have a {i}gigantic{/i} penis and {i}not{/i} the fact that you’re just older, right?
lines.zh: : 你该明白，这一切都跟你那根{i}巨大的{/i}鸡巴有关，{i}而不是{/i}单纯因为你年纪比较大，对吧？

lines.en: : Did that make too much sense?
lines.zh: : 我说得太有道理了吗？

lines.en: : Do you want me to just agree and call you a bad guy for wanting to fuck high school girls? Because that’s not unique to you, Sensei. It’s a top-selling genre at the porn shop for a reason.
lines.zh: : 你想让我干脆附和你，骂你是个想操高中女生的坏人？因为这可不是你独有的，老师。那是色情店里最畅销的类型，总归有它的道理。

lines.en: : But there’s a difference between porn and reality, Makoto. Fetishizing that is completely different from participating in it and I {i}know{/i} you know that because you’re not an idiot.
lines.zh: : 可色情片和现实是有区别的，Makoto。把那种事当成癖好，和真的去做，完全是两码事——我{i}知道{/i}你明白，因为你又不傻。

lines.en: : You’re right. I’m not an idiot.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我不傻。

lines.en: : But I’m also willing to acknowledge the fact that the majority of girls you know can literally {i}not grow up here.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但我也愿意承认一个事实——你认识的大多数女孩，在这个地方{i}根本长不大{/i}。

lines.en: : But that’s-
lines.zh: : 可那是——

lines.en: : Besides, its a person’s {i}mental{/i} maturity that dictates just when it is and isn’t okay to sleep with them. Which isn’t doing you {i}any{/i} favors when it comes to girls like Miku...but think about it.
lines.zh: : 再说，决定什么时候可以和一个人上床的，是{i}心智的{/i}成熟度。这对 Miku 那样的女孩可{i}没什么{/i}帮助……但你想想。

lines.en: : If it was just you and me for a million years...spending time together...getting to know one another...and maturing {i}mentally...{/i}would it {i}still{/i} be wrong to fuck me?
lines.zh: : 如果一百万年里只有你和我……一起度过时光……彼此了解……心智也渐渐{i}成熟……{/i}那和我做爱{i}依然{/i}是错的吗？

lines.en: : Would you deprive me of experiencing everything life has to offer because of an arbitrary number that means {i}nothing{/i} in the face of where and {i}when{/i} we are?
lines.zh: : 你会因为一个在我们所处的{i}时空{/i}里{i}毫无意义的{/i}、任人规定的数字，就剥夺我体验人生一切的可能吗？

lines.en: : At what point is it okay to throw that out the window? How many thousands of years need to pass before that line is drawn?
lines.zh: : 要到什么地步，才能把那条线扔出窗外？要过去几千年，那条线才划得出来？

lines.en: : Hold on...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: scene makotofindsher16
: You’re not as evil as you think, Sensei. You’re really not.
lines.zh: : 你没你自己想的那么邪恶，老师。真的没有。

lines.en: : Expecting you to just keep your hands off of all of us indefinitely until we {i}literally manage to restore the flow of time{/i} is so unreasonable that {i}anyone{/i} would be on your side if they knew.
lines.zh: : 指望你无限期地对我们所有人管住自己的手，直到我们{i}真的恢复了时间的流动{/i}——这种要求不合理到{i}任何人{/i}知道了都会站在你这边。

lines.en: : But they don’t...So you just need to keep believing you’re Satan himself while time ticks infinitely onward and every single one of us stays exactly the same.
lines.zh: : 可他们不知道……所以你只能继续相信自己是撒旦本人，而时间无限地向前走，我们每一个人却都一成不变。

lines.en: : I can only imagine how hard that is for you.
lines.zh: : 我能想象那对你来说有多难。

lines.en: scene makotofindsher17
: And, trust me — I’ve been thinking about it a lot. I’ve had plenty of time lately.
lines.zh: : 而且，相信我——我想了很久。最近我有的是时间。

lines.en: scene makotofindsher18
: Being sincere about any of this is {i}hard{/i} now. Like, I had no idea just how much of an impact {i}time{/i} had on morality until I experienced being stuck like this.
lines.zh: : 现在要对这些事里的任何一件保持真诚都{i}很难{/i}。就像，在亲身体验被困在这里之前，我根本不知道{i}时间{/i}对道德的影响有多大。

lines.en: : When there’s clear direction...and {i}consequences...{/i}all of that stuff makes so much sense. Bad decisions steer reality into the wrong direction and good ones steer it into the right one.
lines.zh: : 当有明确的方向……{i}和后果{/i}时……这些东西都说得通。坏的决定把现实推向错误的方向，好的决定把它推向正确的方向。

lines.en: : Taking those consequences {i}out{/i} of the equation just turns life into a sandbox. It’s a place where, no matter {i}what{/i} we choose to do, we all wind up back at the start.
lines.zh: : 把后果从方程式里{i}拿掉{/i}，人生就变成了一个沙盒。一个不管我们{i}怎么选{/i}，最后都会回到起点的沙盒。

lines.en: : So there can {i}be{/i} no right or wrong anymore. We’re all dogs chained to poles. And we’re hungry, so we’ll eat anything that’s thrown at us. Even if we know it isn’t safe.
lines.zh: : 所以从此{i}再也{/i}没有对错。我们都是拴在桩子上的狗。我们饿，所以扔过来什么都吃。哪怕明知道不安全。

lines.en: : Fill your belly. Go to sleep. Wake up in the sun. That’s it. That’s all we have now.
lines.zh: : 填饱肚子。睡觉。在阳光里醒来。就这样。我们现在只有这些。

lines.en: : Which is why I can only {i}pretend{/i} to be mad at you.
lines.zh: : 所以我只能{i}装作{/i}在生你的气。

lines.en: scene makotofindsher19
: And why I don’t think you’re evil anymore.
lines.zh: : 也所以，我不再觉得你邪恶了。

lines.en: A cat looks on. I have seen it before.
lines.zh: 一只猫在一旁看着。我以前见过它。

lines.en: Its eyes are like marbles. Its fur like the snow.
lines.zh: 它的眼睛像玻璃弹珠。它的毛像雪。

lines.en: : But if time moved normally-
lines.zh: : 可如果时间正常流动——

lines.en: : If everything went back to the way it’s supposed to be...
lines.zh: : 如果一切都回到它该有的样子……

lines.en: : And I was no different from who I am now-
lines.zh: : 而我和现在的我毫无区别——

lines.en: : Would I be evil {i}then?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}我还是邪恶的吗？

lines.en: : Why does it matter? That’s just a hypothetical.
lines.zh: : 那有什么关系？那只是个假设。

lines.en: : What’s real is where and when we are right now. And even in {i}this{/i} world, where time is as infinite as the sky-
lines.zh: : 真正存在的是我们此刻所处的时空。而即便在{i}这个{/i}世界里，时间也像天空一样无穷无尽——

lines.en: : Trying to figure out answers like that is a waste of it.
lines.zh: : 试图找出那种问题的答案，只是在浪费它。

lines.en: : Do you feel any better {i}now?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}现在{/i}感觉好点了吗？

lines.en: : But I...don’t think I’m...supposed to.
lines.zh: : 可我……不觉得我……应该好起来。

lines.en: : Stop caring about what you are or aren’t {i}supposed{/i} to do and just enjoy this gift we’ve been given.
lines.zh: : 别再管什么{i}该不该{/i}了，好好享受我们被赐予的这份礼物吧。

lines.en: : We can rewrite right and wrong here. And if the world was perfect the way it was before...I don’t think we’d have ever made it here at all.
lines.zh: : 我们可以在这里重写对错。而如果之前那个世界是完美的……我想我们根本走不到今天。

lines.en: : Maybe {i}that’s{/i} what we’re supposed to do. {i}Really{/i} start over. Make a {i}new{/i} world.
lines.zh: : 也许{i}这才是{/i}我们该做的事。{i}真正{/i}重新开始。造一个{i}新{/i}世界。

lines.en: : I love you so much.
lines.zh: : 我好爱你。

lines.en: scene black
: How lucky I am to wake up somewhere I can do that forever.
lines.zh: : 能在一个可以永远这么做的清晨醒来，我是多么幸运。

lines.en: scene makotofindsher20
I feel at peace for the first time in months.
lines.zh: 几个月来，我第一次感到了平静。

lines.en: The cool air from the mouth of spring encircles me as I stare off into the night.
lines.zh: 春天入口吹来的凉意环绕着我，我凝望着夜色。

lines.en: I don’t know when exactly Makoto left-
lines.zh: 我不知道 Makoto 究竟是什么时候离开的——

lines.en: But I think that’s the point.
lines.zh: 但我想，这才是重点。

lines.en: scene black
If T is for time or trees and threes then maybe my life isn’t mine.
lines.zh: 如果 T 是时间（time），是树（trees），是三人行（threes）——那我的人生也许并不属于我。

lines.en: If Heaven and Hell and the space in between can’t be seen then I think I’ll be fine.
lines.zh: 如果天堂、地狱与其间的空隙都看不见，那我想我会没事的。

lines.en: I won’t ever get old, I won’t ever die young, I’ll do nothing but live and let love.
lines.zh: 我不会变老，不会英年早逝，我什么也不做，只是活着，并让爱发生。

lines.en: But when living and loving are things I don’t know-
lines.zh: 可当「活着」和「去爱」都是我不懂的事——

lines.en: What exactly does my life consist of?
lines.zh: 那我的人生究竟由什么构成？
